original:
गांधारी शोकसंतप्ता दृष्ट्वा युद्धमहीमृषाम् ।
चकार करुणं विलापं जगत्संमोहकारकम् ॥
sanskrit:
गांधारी शोकसंतप्ता दृष्ट्वा युद्धमहीमृषाम् ।
चकार करुणं विलापं जगत्संमोहकारकम् ॥
transliteration:
gāndhārī śokasaṃtaptā dṛṣṭvā yuddhamahīm ṛṣām |
cakāra karuṇaṃ vilāpaṃ jagatsaṃmohakārakam ||
translation: Queen Gandhari, stricken with grief upon beholding the carnage of the battlefield, gave voice to a poignant lamentation moving all of humanity.

layers.author: gita_press
layers.content: शोकसंतप्त महारानी गांधारी ने युद्धभूमि का दृश्य देखकर अत्यंत कारुणिक विलाप किया, जिसने सम्पूर्ण संसार को द्रवित कर दिया।

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: शोकसंतप्त राणी गांधारीने रणांगणाचे दृश्य पाहून अत्यंत हृदयद्रावक विलाप केला, ज्याने संपूर्ण जगाला हेलावून सोडले.

layers.author: km_ganguli
layers.content: Stri Parva presents one of the most powerful anti-war laments in world literature as mothers, widows, and orphans mourn the fallen heroes.

layers.author: bori
layers.content: Gandhari's lament culminates in her blessing of peace and historic prophecy on the Yadu dynasty.
